paragraphs.text:
By accident or cunning, the creature’s trail leads into a stream. 
Try as you might, you cannot pick up the spoor. Frustrated, 
Norman kicks the bank.

To strike out at random in search of Sylvia, go to 292. To abandon 
your efforts and return to civilization, go to 278. To give up the 
search, but explore this lost valley, go to 38.
